comparison.objective: Cover three battery terminals and place the batteries in a recycling box.
comparison.physical_skill: Push-fit cover installation followed by repeated pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: All batteries must be boxed with covers seated; bare insertion and drops are failures. Numeric seating and hold limits are supplied.
comparison.reason: Simple external cover seating and sorting do not test recessed latch depression, sustained extraction-tool engagement, or opposing wire traction.
